charts.name: daily_active_accounts
charts.query:
SELECT block_date, COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) as daily_active_accounts
                FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
                WHERE block_date >= @start_date AND block_date < @end_date
                GROUP BY block_date ORDER BY block_date
charts.takeaway: Daily active accounts moved up over the period (55503 → 85595), based on 30 days of BigQuery data.

charts.name: transaction_counts
charts.query:
SELECT block_date, COUNT(*) as tx_count
                FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
                WHERE block_date >= @start_date AND block_date < @end_date
                GROUP BY block_date ORDER BY block_date
charts.takeaway: 30 days of transactions totaling 20,344,165 (avg 678,139/day) from BigQuery.

charts.name: contract_usage
charts.query:
SELECT receipt_receiver_account_id AS receiver_id, COUNT(*) as call_count
                FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions`
                WHERE block_date >= @start_date AND block_date < @end_date
                  AND action_kind = 'FUNCTION_CALL'
                GROUP BY receiver_id ORDER BY call_count DESC LIMIT 20
charts.takeaway: game.hot.tg is the most-called contract with 1952431 calls, based on 10 contracts from BigQuery.

charts.name: intents_swap_volume
charts.query: GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions; params={"direction":"next","endTimestamp":"2026-11-14T00:00:00+00:00","numberOfTransactions":1000,"startTimestamp":"2026-10-15T00:00:00+00:00","statuses":"SUCCESS"}; locally restrict to 2026-11-07T00:00:00+00:00 <= createdAt < 2026-11-14T00:00:00+00:00; sum amountInUsd by UTC date
